Agra Shop Collapses After Heavy Rain, Multiple People Trapped

A shop in Agra's Subhash Bazaar collapsed following heavy rainfall. Reports indicate that three to five people were trapped under the debris. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has taken cognizance of the incident.
